pkgmetadata.longdescription: KDE Infinit Desktop turns every monitor into an infinite canvas: windows are placed on a plane that can be panned and zoomed freely with the mouse, the touchpad, a touchscreen or the keyboard. It is an effect for KWin (KDE Plasma 6 on Wayland) with a System Settings module and a settings app. It has to be rebuilt after every kde-plasma/kwin update.
